evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results.
